name: copilot-cli
description: GitHub Copilot CLI built-in tools, as listed for --available-tools in the Copilot CLI command reference (GitHub Docs, 2026-10). The shell tool is `bash` on Linux and macOS and `powershell` on Windows; both families are listed, and shell=true grants a shell either way. MCP-server, extension and plugin tools are not built in and are excluded.
